translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

book.name: Nauman gail
book.title: Nauman gail Nǝsa ahai pispisul gail lotogole

content: APol mai aSilas len naut a Tessalonika
Nǝboŋ aPol galit lotoyar tur len naut a Amfip̃olis mai a Ap̃ollonia, lubar naut a Tessalonika, naut enan tokad naim nab̃onb̃onan seJu gail.
Sum̃an naṽide san, aPol eb̃is lan ale len nǝSappat itor ikel ur mai galito nǝsa natosian siGot tokele.

Isor vahvah mai galito hǝn b̃eṽusan len natosian siGot ke, aKristo, aGot totabtabuh lan imaslǝŋon isa vǝmat mai imasle mǝhat dan nǝmatan. Ale aPol ike, “AYesu egaii notokel uri mai gamito, evi aKristo boh.”
Galit galevis lodǝlom nǝsa aPol tokele ale lub̃on mai aPol mai aSilas. Isob̃ur am lutah mai gǝlaru: alat a Kris lotolotu hǝn aGot, mai alatpǝhaṽut lotoil a m̃o len nab̃iltivile enan.

Be naJu lǝsadǝlom nasoruan siPol lutab̃ulol bulos gǝlaru, ale losǝhar naulum̃an galevis lotosa dan nǝmaket, lugol nǝvanuan gail loluṽoh hǝn lǝb̃ib̃al taṽtaṽor, mǝdas natit gail len nab̃iltivile enan. Lom̃ur van hǝn naim siJason hǝn lǝb̃idoŋ aPol mai aSilas hǝn lǝb̃ipat kuv gǝlaru vivile van hǝn naluṽoh.

Nǝboŋ lǝsǝsab̃ gǝlaru, loliv gargar aJason mai nǝvanuan nadǝlomian gail tile van hǝn alat lotoil a m̃o len nab̃iltivile enan. Lukai habat ke, “Nǝvanuan galegai lotomǝdas naut p̃isi, gagai logǝm gegai.
Ale Jason egai ehǝhaṽur hǝn lototoh lohoim san. Galit p̃isi lob̃ur kotov nalo seSisa a Rom, luke ikad nakiŋ tile, nahǝsan aYesu!”
Nǝboŋ naluṽoh mai alat lotoil a m̃o lotosǝsǝloŋ hǝn natgalenan, lodǝdarŋab̃u masuṽ.
Imagenan lugol ke aJason mai nǝvanuan nadǝlomian gail lulav nǝvat mai galito hum na-kel-gati-an ke asike lomǝdas naut tǝtas am, ale loriŋ galito luvan.
APol mai aSilas len naut a Perea
Len mariug enan ŋai nǝvanuan nadǝlomian gail losǝvat aPol mai aSilas vi Perea. Nǝboŋ artobar naut enan arob̃is len naim nab̃onb̃onan seJu gail.

Len nab̃oruan salito, alat a Perea lohǝhaṽur hǝn lǝb̃esǝsǝdariŋ sǝhor alat a Tessalonika. Lolǝŋon masuṽ hǝn lǝb̃esǝsǝloŋ hǝn nasoruan. Len nǝboŋ p̃isi lobunus tas natosian siGot hǝn lǝb̃isab̃i ke aPol tokitin o sakitin.
Imagenan galit lusob̃ur lodǝlom nasoruan siGot; galevis lotovi tob̃taKris lotoṽat nǝhes mai auleKris isob̃ur.

Be nǝboŋ naJu gail len naut a Tessalonika lotosǝsǝloŋ lǝboii ke aPol tokel ur nasoruan siGot mai alat a Perea, luvan ei ale lusor tas aPol len naluṽoh, gol nǝlol paŋpaŋ mai nab̃iltidǝdarŋab̃uan len navile enan.
Beti vǝha-sua ŋai nǝvanuan nadǝlomian gail losǝvat aPol vi tut, vi lau len nabitas, be aSilas mai aTimoti arutoh.
Alat lotosǝhar aPol luyar maii vǝbar naut a Atens ale nǝboŋ lototǝlmam, lulav napisulan siPol ke, aSilas mai aTimoti aregǝm tah mai aPol tutut.
Len naut a Atens
Nǝboŋ aPol totoh vir gǝlaru len naut a Atens, nǝlon isa bathut eris ke nab̃iltivile epul hǝn nǝlablab tiltile lotolotu hǝni.
Ŋa isor vahvah len naim nab̃onb̃onan mai naJu gail mai alat lǝsavi Ju lotolotlotu hǝn aGot. Ale len nǝboŋ p̃isi len nǝmaket ihol mai alat lototoh ei.
Ahai p̃usan gail, lotokis galit hǝn Epikurian
mai Stoik

, lusor levlev mai aPol. Galevis luke, “Ategai tosor tavtav, gai ike tikel nǝsa?” Galevis am luke, “Esum̃an tovi ulum̃an na-kel-uri-an hǝn nagot dattotǝtan hǝn gail.” (Lokǝmaienan husur ikel ur aYesu mai na-le-mǝhat-an dan nǝmatan.)
Ŋa losǝhar aPol van hǝn nǝkaunsel hǝn nǝAreopakus.
Nǝmatsistret gail lotobǝtah lan lousi ke, “Namtuke namtelǝboi nap̃usanan veveu gotokel uri.
Namtosǝsǝloŋ hǝn natgalevis lototile masuṽ ale namtuke namtelǝboi namilelito.”
Alat a Atens mai nametb̃os gail lototoh ei, lusorsor husur mai losǝsǝloŋ tabtab hǝn nǝnauan ideh toveveu.
Beti aPol eil rivuh hǝn nǝAreopakus ike, “Alat a Atens, noris ke, mǝttonau masuṽ hǝn nalotuan van hǝn nagot samit gail.

Husur nǝboŋ notoyar tur len naut egai, nokǝta bunus natit mǝttolotu hǝn gail. Ale nusab̃ nǝmel tutumavan sua tokad natosian lan. Ike, ‘Van hǝn Nagot Datsalǝboii.’ Nǝsa mǝttolotu hǝni be mǝtsalǝboii, ategai nikel uri mai gamito.
AGot togol navile a pan mai natit p̃isi lan, atenan tovi Nasub̃ hǝn nǝmav mai navile a pan, gai satoh len naim nalotuan nǝvanuan lotoum hǝn gail.
Mai nǝvanuan gail lǝsalǝboi lǝb̃evi tarhǝt san husur gai sǝpar titideh bathut gai sǝb̃on eviol mai nǝvanuan p̃isi hǝn nǝmauran, nasuŋavŋavan mai natit p̃isi am.
Len nǝvanuan esua ŋai igol naluṽoh p̃isi hǝn nǝvanuan tiltile gail, hǝn lǝb̃itoh len navile a pan kavkav. Ale eriŋ gat nǝboŋ hǝn natohan salito mai naut a im salito.
Igol natgalenan hǝn lǝb̃iyar kitev aGot, mai hum ma lǝb̃itaŋtaŋ kitevi ale sab̃i, naut kǝmas ke satoh a tut dan gidat ṽisusua.
Bathut

content.text: datugol natideh dattogole mai datukad natohan.’

content: Hum galevis silat lototos nǝb̃e samito luke,
Imagenan, husur ke dattovi anatun aGot gail, sadatinau ke esum̃an nǝlablab hǝn nagol, nasilva o nǝvat mot, nǝlablab nǝvanuan toum hǝni len namitisau mai nǝnauan san.
A m̃o aGot sǝpansem alat lototǝtan hǝn nakitinan husuri. Ehum tokǝta sǝhor natǝtanan enan. Be len nǝboŋ ta damǝŋai van, isor idaŋ mai nǝvanuan p̃isi len naut p̃isi ke, lipair dan nǝsaan salito.

Bathut aGot ilekis hǝn nǝboŋ tia hǝn ke, len nanoran gai dereh tikot hǝn nǝvanuan p̃isi len navile a pan. AGot gatotabtabuh len avan sua hǝn b̃ikot hǝn galito. Ale igol avan enan ip̃arp̃ar nǝboŋ togol tole mǝhat dan nǝmatan.”
Nǝboŋ lotosǝsǝloŋ hǝn aPol tosor husur na-le-mǝhat-an dan nǝmatan, galevis lusor vilesi, luman sili, be galevis am luke, “Namtuke namtesǝsǝloŋ hǝn gaiug tǝtas husur natenan.”
Imagenan aPol eriŋ galito.
Be galit galevis lutah maii, ale lukad nadǝlomian len aYesu: ikad aTionisius, tobǝtah len nǝAreopakus; apǝhaṽut sua, nahǝsan aTamaris, mai nǝvanuan galevis am.

footnotes.text: 17.18 Epikurian gail lodǝlomi ke, nǝmauran ipat m̃os nahǝhaṽuran, ale b̃ikad nagot ideh, nǝvanuan lovi ut kǝmas hǝn galito.
17.18 Stoik gail lodǝlomi ke, nǝvanuan ŋai ikad nǝnauan tonor hǝn b̃ekǝta tǝban gai sǝb̃on. Lunau ke, got evi natit p̃isi len navile a pan ale nǝvanuan p̃isi mai natit p̃isi lop̃itp̃itoṽ.
17.19 NǝAreopakus evi naṽehuh sua tokad nahǝsan nagot hǝn nǝb̃alan salito mai lokis nǝmatsistret gail lotobǝtah len nǝkaunsel nǝAreopakus am.
